title: Data Engineer
description:
After clicking Apply, you'll be invited to create a profile on the Via website to complete your application. This doesn't guarantee you'll be matched to this specific role - Via reviews every application (AI first, then a human checks the fit) and shortlists the right candidates. Your profile also stays active for other relevant roles on the platform, and stays anonymous until you match. It takes just a few minutes.

Salary: £70,000–£85,000 per year

Location: Hybrid working from any of their 35 locations across the UK

About the opportunity

Via is partnering with a leading UK professional services firm looking for a Data Engineer to develop and support its Microsoft Fabric-based enterprise data platform.

You'll build reliable data pipelines, dimensional models and analytics solutions, helping the business make better use of its data.

What you'll be doing
  • Develop and maintain data pipelines using Microsoft Fabric
  • Build dimensional models and data transformations using dbt
  • Support enterprise data warehousing and Medallion architecture
  • Develop Power BI semantic models, reports and dashboards
  • Implement data quality, testing and monitoring standards
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to deliver reporting and analytics solutions
  • Support CI/CD, automation and platform improvements
What we're looking for
  • Strong Microsoft Fabric data engineering experience
  • Advanced SQL and experience with PySpark
  • Experience with dbt and Kimball dimensional modelling
  • Knowledge of ETL/ELT pipelines and Medallion architecture
  • Experience with Git, Azure DevOps and CI/CD
  • Understanding of enterprise data warehousing and data quality
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills

Experience with Power BI, Python, APIs or professional services would be advantageous.

Why apply?
  • £70,000–£85,000 annual salary
  • Flexible remote/hybrid working
  • Opportunity to develop a modern Microsoft Fabric data platform
  • Significant ownership of technical delivery
  • Training, certifications and career development
  • Exposure to enterprise-scale data and analytics projects
